summary: Single-engine Socata TBM700 crashed into Ridgway Reservoir around 2 p.m. Saturday after going into a flat spin coming out of thick clouds, landing ~90 ft offshore in 60-90 ft of water; all 5 Alabama occupants killed (Jimmy L. Hill, 48; Katrina Vinzant Barksdale, 40; her sons Xander Barksdale, 8 and Kobe Barksdale, 11; her cousin Seth McDuffie, 14); wreckage and all bodies recovered March 27, 2014 by specialized dive teams and handed to the NTSB/FAA; Ouray County Emergency Operations Plan records 1,500+ labor hours and ~$75,000 recovery cost
notes: Flight: Gadsden AL origin, Bartlesville OK stop, en route to Montrose. Eyewitness (Lena Martinez): plane popped out of clouds and went into a flat spin. NTSB preliminary: pilot reported plane in a spin before losing communication. Tail recovered Saturday; fuselage and victims recovered Thursday 3/27 by Beegles Aircraft Service divers (Greeley CO) + Inland Marine extraction of the 5,000-lb plane from ~60 ft of water + 3 ft of silt; Ridgway State Park campground/day facilities closed during the op. Curecanti dive team + NPS Submerged Resources Center assisted the recovery (VideoRay ROV/side-scan sonar wreckage mapping, safety vessel, post-recovery CSP hazmat cleanup) per the NPS morning-report 2014-04-01 entry. SARDOC 2014 report corroboration.
